q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a car seat cover set?
title: Car seat cover carbon footprint per set
short: Measure the fabric or artificial leather per set, multiply by the supplier's figure, and add foam backing, thread and fittings. Add cutting and stitching energy, then divide the unit's energy by sets made.
audience: Seat cover makers and automotive trim suppliers

ul: Fabric, PU or PVC artificial leather.

p: Report per set by vehicle model and material.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per set (one month)
lines: Plant total: 5,680 / 5,000 = 1.136 kg CO2 per set
Add fabric or artificial leather and foam for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
